result.summary: The page is largely intact, but the free-delivery promo banner has a text-contrast problem that makes its headline and supporting details hard to read.

issues.description: The promotional banner's white headline and subtitle text are nearly invisible against the light mint-green background, making the offer details difficult to read.
issues.suggestion: Use dark text or a darker/contrasting banner background so the headline, code, and minimum-order details are legible.

issues.description: The 'Order now' button label is green on a white pill with low contrast, and the banner's faint white text would be hard to read for users with low vision.
issues.suggestion: Darken the button text and increase contrast between the banner text and its background.
